quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention
claim: 作者指出，自注意力将任意两位置间的操作数降为常数，但代价是注意力加权位置平均导致有效分辨率降低，他们用多头注意力来抵消这一影响 [S2.p1]。

quote: The decoder is also composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器整体结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力与逐位置全连接前馈网络，并配有残差连接和层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths, as memory constraints limit batching across examples.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿序列位置逐步计算，其固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
claim: 作者还表示计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大输入输出 [S7.p3]。

quote: For English-French, we used the significantly larger WMT 2014 English-French dataset consisting of 36M sentences
claim: 训练数据为 WMT 2014 英德数据集（约 450 万句对）和 WMT 2014 英法数据集（3600 万句） [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: We use BART-large, a pre-trained seq2seq transformer with 400M parameters.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1})（BART-large）[S2.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: In one approach, RAG-Sequence, the model uses the same document to predict each target token.
claim: 检索文档被视为隐变量，通过 top-K 近似进行边缘化，分为 RAG-Sequence（整段序列使用同一文档）和 RAG-Token（每个 token 可使用不同文档）[S2.p2]。

quote: In these cases, once retrieval had collapsed, the generator would learn to ignore the documents, and the RAG model would perform equivalently to BART.
claim: 在初步实验中，某些任务（如故事生成）的检索组件会“崩溃”，无论输入如何都检索相同文档，此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: As FEVER uses a different Wikipedia dump to us, directly tackling this task is not straightforward. We hope to address this in future work.
claim: 作者指出，FEVER 的另一个子任务（抽取支持分类预测的维基百科句子）因 FEVER 使用不同的 Wikipedia dump 而难以直接处理，留待未来工作 [A5.p1]。

quote: We argue that this is because of overfitting. The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset.
claim: 作者指出，1202层网络测试结果差于110层网络，认为这是因为过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大，本文未使用maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: In addition, we have performed multi-scale testing only for the Fast R-CNN step (but not yet for the RPN step).
claim: 此外，作者提到多尺度训练因时间有限未进行，多尺度测试也仅用于Fast R-CNN步骤而未用于RPN步骤 [A2.p5]。

quote: The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins (Table 3 and 5).
claim: 50/101/152层ResNet比34层ResNet准确率更高，未观察到退化问题，并从深度增加中获得显著准确率提升 [S4.SS1.p15]。

quote: The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart.
claim: 作者指出，按照构造，更深模型不应比其较浅对应模型产生更高的训练误差，但实验表明当前求解器无法找到与构造解相当或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

quote: We do not observe the degradation problem and thus enjoy significant accuracy gains from considerably increased depth.
claim: 50/101/152层ResNet比34层ResNet准确率更高，未观察到退化问题，并从深度增加中获得显著准确率提升 [S4.SS1.p15]。

quote: during training, DeepSeek-R1-Zero exhibits an “aha moment” (Table 2), characterized by a sudden increase in the use of the word “wait” during reflections
claim: 训练过程中模型自然涌现出反思、验证等高级推理行为，并出现“aha moment” [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: Their dependence on human-annotated reasoning traces hinders scalability and introduces cognitive biases.
claim: 现有方法依赖人工标注的推理轨迹，限制了可扩展性并引入认知偏差，且模型性能受限于人类示例，无法探索更优的非人类推理路径 [S1.p1]。

quote: we aim to explore the potential of LLMs for developing reasoning abilities through self-evolution in an RL framework, with minimal reliance on human labeling efforts.
claim: 论文旨在探索大语言模型能否通过强化学习在最小化人工标注依赖的情况下自我演化出推理能力 [S1.p2]。

quote: by constraining models to replicate human thought processes, their performance is inherently capped by the human-provided exemplars, which prevents the exploration of superior, non-human-like reasoning pathways.
claim: 现有方法依赖人工标注的推理轨迹，限制了可扩展性并引入认知偏差，且模型性能受限于人类示例，无法探索更优的非人类推理路径 [S1.p1]。

quote: we introduce DeepSeek-R1, a model trained through a multi-stage learning framework that integrates rejection sampling, reinforcement learning, and supervised fine-tuning
claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1，作者采用多阶段框架，整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调，并引入语言一致性奖励以缓解语言混杂问题 [S1.p3][S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: We perform supervised finetuning on Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using s1K to obtain our model s1-32B
claim: 论文在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上使用 s1K 进行监督微调，训练在 16 块 H100 GPU 上耗时 26 分钟 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学问题上超过 o1-preview 最高达 27%（MATH 和 AIME24） [abstract]。

quote: Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
claim: 数据消融表明，结合质量、难度、多样性三个准则至关重要，随机选择、仅选最长推理轨迹或仅选最大多样性均导致性能显著下降（AIME24 平均约 -30%） [S1.p3]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，找到实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法 [S1.p1]。

quote: scaling s1-32B with budget forcing allows extrapolating beyond its performance without test-time intervention: from 50% to 57% on AIME24
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学问题上超过 o1-preview 最高达 27%（MATH 和 AIME24） [abstract]。

quote: we include diverse mathematical competitions like OlympiadBench to test performance on different mathematical challenges.
claim: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500、AMC23 上评估，并在分布外基准上测试，包括 OlympiadBench、中文多语言基准 CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool，以及多学科基准 Minerva 和 GPQA [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: we observe diminishing returns beyond 800 samples, with only marginal increases between LIMO-800 and LIMO-1k2
claim: 分析显示推理链质量与模型性能正相关，L5 训练模型在 AIME24 和 MATH500 上最高 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p3]；仅改变问题难度即可在 AIME2024 上带来 16% 准确率提升，Advanced-500 微调模型在 MATH500 上达到 91.2% [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；预训练模型选择影响显著，LIMO 在 AIME2024 上比 Qwen1.5 高 54.1 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；模型规模增大时 AIME24 性能从 3B 的 2.5 升至 72B 的 68.3，但 32B 与 72B 在 MATH500 上差异很小 [S6.SS3.SSS4.p1]；仅 400 样本即可将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升至 57.5，超过 800 样本后收益递减 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: LIMO achieves the highest average performance of 78.1% across all benchmarks, substantially outperforming OpenAI-o1-preview, QwQ-32B-Preview, and other baselines.
claim: LIMO 在所有基准上的平均性能为 78.1%，超过 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview 等基线 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

quote: We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
claim: 评估采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1 指标，大基准用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的小基准生成 4 个样本并计算无偏 pass@1，最大输出长度 32,768 token [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: Results in Figure 4 show that modifying problem selection alone leads to 16% accuracy improvement on AIME2024, reaching 51.5%.
claim: 分析显示推理链质量与模型性能正相关，L5 训练模型在 AIME24 和 MATH500 上最高 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p3]；仅改变问题难度即可在 AIME2024 上带来 16% 准确率提升，Advanced-500 微调模型在 MATH500 上达到 91.2% [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；预训练模型选择影响显著，LIMO 在 AIME2024 上比 Qwen1.5 高 54.1 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；模型规模增大时 AIME24 性能从 3B 的 2.5 升至 72B 的 68.3，但 32B 与 72B 在 MATH500 上差异很小 [S6.SS3.SSS4.p1]；仅 400 样本即可将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升至 57.5，超过 800 样本后收益递减 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
claim: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo 在所有系统中表现最佳，解决了完整 SWE-bench 测试集的 12.47%（286/2,294）和 Lite 子集的 18.00%（54/300）[S5.p1]。

quote: At each step, SWE-agent generates a thought and a command, then incorporates the feedback from the command’s execution in the environment
claim: ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件，智能体每步生成一个 thought 和一个 command，并纳入执行反馈 [S3.p1]。

quote: we investigate whether LM agents could similarly benefit from better-designed interfaces for performing software engineering tasks.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：如何设计适合语言模型智能体的计算机接口，以提升其在软件工程等复杂任务上的表现 [S1.p1][S2.p1]。

quote: SWE-agent’s ACI instead offers a small set of simple actions for viewing, searching through and editing files.
claim: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 和 ACI 组成的系统，使 LM 能自主使用计算机解决软件工程任务 [S1.p3]。

quote: The results show that SWE-agent solves $10.7$ percentage points more instances than the baseline agent, which uses only the default Linux shell.
claim: 消融实验显示，SWE-agent 比仅使用默认 Linux shell 的基线多解决 10.7 个百分点 [S1.p4]。

quote: Similarly, on GSM8K, Quiet-STaR results in a 5.0% boost over the base model
claim: 在 OpenWebMath 上训练后，Quiet-STaR 在 CommonsenseQA 上比基础模型提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且提升随理由 token 数增加而增大 [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: for our C4 evaluation, we train Mistral 7B with 16 thought tokens and 4 true tokens ahead and otherwise the same setup
claim: 作者也在 C4 上评估，使用 16 个思考 token 和 4 个真实 token 前瞻的设置 [S5.SS1.p2]。

quote: We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
claim: 实验以 Mistral 7B 为基础模型 [S5.p1]。

quote: Quiet-STaR operates with three main steps (Figure 1): 1. Parallel rationale generation (think, Subsection 4.2)
claim: 方法分三步：在所有 token 位置并行生成理由并插入可学习的思考起止 token；用混合头决定后思考预测与基础预测的融合权重；用 REINFORCE 优化理由生成，并采用非近视的教师强制技巧纳入多个未来 token [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: 3. Optimizing rationale generation (learn, Subsection 4.4)
claim: 方法分三步：在所有 token 位置并行生成理由并插入可学习的思考起止 token；用混合头决定后思考预测与基础预测的融合权重；用 REINFORCE 优化理由生成，并采用非近视的教师强制技巧纳入多个未来 token [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: • Llama 3: Llama-3-8B, Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Llama-3-70B-Instruct. • Gemma: Gemma-2B, Gemma-7B. • Pythia: Pythia-70M through Pythia-12B (eight models in total).
claim: 此外还扩展到 Llama 3、Gemma、Pythia 等不同规模（70M-70B）和训练阶段的模型，在 MATH 和 CodeContests 上评估 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3]。

quote: 1) We generate many independent candidate solutions for a given problem by sampling from an LLM with a positive temperature. 2) We use a domain-specific verifier (ex. unit tests for code) to select a final answer from the generated samples.
claim: 论文采用重复采样方法：对每个问题，用正温度从语言模型独立采样大量候选解，再用领域特定的验证器（如代码单元测试、Lean4 证明检查器）从样本中选出最终答案 [S1.F1]。

quote: However, when interacting with LLMs, users and developers often restrict models to making only one attempt when solving a problem.
claim: 作者指出，尽管训练计算扩展已被广泛研究，但推理阶段的计算投入相对有限，用户和开发者通常只让模型对一个问题尝试一次 [S1.p2]。

quote: Interestingly, the relationship between $\log(\text{coverage})$ and the number of samples often follows an approximate power law (Section 3).
claim: 覆盖率随样本数增加而提升，在多个任务和模型上跨越四个数量级，且覆盖率与样本数的关系常可用指数幂律建模 [S1.p7][S3.p2]。

quote: We restrict evaluation to the MATH and CodeContests datasets to minimize inference costs, reporting results in Figure 3.
claim: 此外还扩展到 Llama 3、Gemma、Pythia 等不同规模（70M-70B）和训练阶段的模型，在 MATH 和 CodeContests 上评估 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3]。

quote: GPT-3 also displays one-shot and few-shot proficiency at tasks designed to test rapid adaption or on-the-fly reasoning, which include unscrambling words, performing arithmetic, and using novel words in a sentence after seeing them defined only once.
claim: GPT-3 还在解乱词、算术运算和仅见一次定义后使用新词等即时推理任务上表现出单样本和少样本能力 [S1.p12]。

quote: we develop systematic tools to measure data contamination and quantify its distorting effects
claim: 作者还系统研究了数据污染问题，构建保守的“干净”基准子集并比较原始分数与干净子集分数 [S1.p15][S4.p5][S4.p6]。

quote: For many of these tasks it is difficult to collect a large supervised training dataset, especially when the process must be repeated for every new task.
claim: 作者认为去除这一限制是可取的，因为许多有用任务难以收集大规模监督训练数据，且微调范式可能利用训练数据中的虚假相关、泛化到分布外表现较差 [S1.p3][S1.p4]。

quote: Thus our design decision comes at the cost of potentially worse performance on tasks which empirically benefit from bidirectionality.
claim: 作者还指出结构性和算法性局限：实验未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能以牺牲某些任务性能为代价 [S5.p3]。

quote: We use the same model and architecture as GPT-2, including the modified initialization, pre-normalization, and reversible tokenization described therein
claim: 论文训练了一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，其规模是此前任何非稀疏语言模型的 10 倍，并采用与 GPT-2 相同的模型和架构，但在 transformer 层中使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式 [abstract][S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: These evaluations cover eight top-level categories: (1) commonsense reasoning; (2) knowledge; (3) reading comprehension; (4) math, reasoning, and problem solving; (5) long context; (6) code; (7) adversarial evaluations; and (8) aggregate evaluations.
claim: 论文在大量标准基准上评估了预训练和后训练模型，涵盖常识推理、知识、阅读理解、数学推理、长上下文、代码、对抗评估等类别 [S5.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
claim: 论文旨在开发一套新的基础语言模型 Llama 3，使其原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用，并在质量上与领先语言模型竞争 [S1.p3][S1.p6]。

quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
claim: 实验表明，Llama 3 旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先模型表现相当，较小模型在同规模中表现最佳 [S1.p6]。

quote: The recipe used to pre-train Llama 3 405B consists of three main stages: (1) initial pre-training, (2) long-context pre-training, and (3) annealing.
claim: 预训练配方包括初始预训练、长上下文预训练和退火三个阶段 [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: However, no testing can be guaranteed to be exhaustive in identifying every possible risk.
claim: 安全方面，没有测试能保证穷尽所有风险，Llama 3 仍可能生成有害内容，尤其针对英语之外的语言和熟练对抗性红队攻击 [S5.SS4.SSS8.p1]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B model sets the new state-of-the-art due to curated training data and excellent capability of LLM models.
claim: 在文档与 OCR 方面，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 CC-OCR 和 OmniDocBench 上创下新最优，在 OCRBench_v2 上英文和中文赛道分别超过 Gemini 1.5-Pro 9.6% 和 20.6% [S3.SS3.SSS2.p2][S3.SS3.SSS2.p4]。

quote: On MathVista, it achieves a score of 74.8, outperforming the previous open-source state-of-the-art score of 72.3.
claim: 在数学任务上，MathVista 得分 74.8，超过此前开源最优的 72.3 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: we conducted extensive experiments across a diverse range of datasets.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B scores 51.1, surpassing the previous open-source state-of-the-art models and achieving performance comparable to GPT-4o.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 MMMU 上取得 70.2 分，在 MMMU-Pro 上取得 51.1 分，超过此前开源最优模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: only four layers employ full self-attention, while the remaining layers utilize windowed attention with a maximum window size of 112×112
claim: 视觉编码器采用重新设计的 ViT，引入 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生分辨率并加速计算，大部分层使用窗口注意力，仅四层使用全自注意力 [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: Movie Gen Audio, outperforms prior state-of-the-art, including commercial systems such as PikaLabs and ElevenLabs for sound-effect generation
claim: Movie Gen Audio 在音效生成、音乐生成和音频扩展上优于先前最优，包括 PikaLabs 和 ElevenLabs 等商业系统 [S1.p3]。

quote: We present Movie Gen, a cast of media generation foundation models.
claim: 论文旨在为 AI 系统赋予生成、组合和预测媒体（图像、视频、音频）的能力，这是一个具有广泛应用的核心科学挑战 [S1.p1]。

quote: Equipping AI systems with such generative, compositional, and prediction capabilities is a core scientific challenge with broad applications.

claim: 训练分两阶段：先以去噪扩散模型在基态材料数据上预训练，再微调为预测能量、力和应力的神经网络势 [S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: For both sections, Orb models set a new state-of-the art across the primary metric (F1), and are generally superior across other metrics.
claim: Orb 在 Matbench Discovery 上设定了新的 state-of-the-art，尤其在精确度上表现突出 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Orb demonstrates excellent stability, achieving the maximum 300ps for all molecules, putting it on par with NequIP and ahead of all other baseline models.
claim: 在 MD17-10k 上，系统特定微调的 Orb 在所有分子上达到最大 300ps 稳定性，与 NequIP 相当 [S3.SS4.SSSx1.Px1.p1]。

quote: Orb models have especially high precision, which would likely be crucial in a real-world use-case where false-positives (i.e. materials that are predicted as stable but are not) are very costly due to wasted experimental effort.
claim: Orb 在 Matbench Discovery 上设定了新的 state-of-the-art，尤其在精确度上表现突出 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Using a 72-qubit processor, we implement a distance-5 surface code operating with an integrated real-time decoder.
claim: 作者在 105 量子比特处理器上实现距离-7 表面码存储器，包含 49 个数据量子比特、48 个测量量子比特和 4 个额外的泄漏移除量子比特，并在 72 量子比特处理器上实现距离-5 表面码 [S2.p3][S1.p3]。

quote: We run a dedicated experiment on our 72-qubit processor to compare real-time decoding to high-accuracy offline neural network decoding of the same data, with the results shown in Fig. 4 c.
claim: 此外，他们还在 72 量子比特处理器上测试实时解码，将距离-5 表面码运行至 10^6 个周期，并比较实时解码与离线神经网络解码的精度 [S5.p3][S5.p4]。

quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是实现并验证表面码量子纠错在物理错误率低于阈值时的性能，从而获得随码距增加而指数抑制的逻辑错误率 [S1.p1]。

quote: Extrapolating the projections in Fig. 1 d, achieving a $10^{-6}$ error rate would require a distance-27 logical qubit using 1457 physical qubits.
claim: 作者指出，尽管原则上可以通过扩大当前处理器实现低逻辑错误率，但在实践中资源消耗巨大；外推预测显示，达到 10^-6 错误率需要距离-27 的逻辑量子比特，使用 1457 个物理量子比特 [S6.p3]。

quote: We employ a specialized version of the Sparse Blossom algorithm optimized to quickly resolve local configurations of errors common in surface code decoding, using a parallelization strategy similar to Ref..
claim: 此外，作者还实现了基于 Sparse Blossom 的实时解码系统，采用分块并行化和常数大小的图缓冲区 [S5.p2]。

quote: However, we repeat the caveat that the limits are substantially relaxed in more extended dark energy models that affect the background geometry, such as those in Section 5.
claim: 作者指出，中微子质量上限强烈依赖于∑mν的先验选择，且在扩展暗能量模型中显著放宽 [S7.SS1.p7][S7.SS1.p9]。

quote: All Bayesian inference is performed using the Metropolis-Hastings MCMC sampler in cobaya.
claim: 宇宙学推断使用cobaya中的Metropolis-Hastings MCMC采样器，结合CAMB玻尔兹曼代码，并对外部数据集（BBN、CMB、SN Ia）进行联合分析 [S2.SS5.p1][S2.SS5.p3]。

quote: It remains important to thoroughly examine unaccounted-for sources of systematic uncertainties or inconsistencies between the different datasets that might be contributing to these results.
claim: 作者还提醒，当前结果中与ΛCDM的偏差可能受到未考虑的系统误差或数据集间不一致性的影响 [S8.p7]。

quote: To mitigate against the possibility of such biases unknowingly entering into our analyses, we apply a system of blinding our data, to conceal the true cosmological results during the period where systematic errors were being investigated and analysis pipelines finalised.
claim: 为减轻确认偏差，实施了盲分析，在系统误差调查和管线最终确定期间隐藏真实宇宙学结果 [S2.SS3.SSS1.p2]。

quote: In this paper, we make use of three different SN Ia datasets.
claim: 外部数据集包括BBN先验、Planck和ACT的CMB数据（温度、极化及透镜），以及三个Ia型超新星数据集：Pantheon+、Union3和DES-SN5YR [S2.SS4.SSS1.p1][S2.SS4.SSS2.p3][S2.SS4.SSS3.p2]。

quote: A more detailed quantitative analysis of this scenario will be explored in future work.

quote: However, this extremely red SED color does not match the JWST MIRI photometric data for LRDs, which suggest a modest red color or even a flat spectral shape.
claim: 在红外，当密度集中（γ=1–2）或n0≳10^3 cm^-3时，热尘埃导致近红外过亮，与MIRI数据不符；而较低密度（n0=10–100 cm^-3）使较冷尘埃主导，能量峰值移到中远红外，SED变平，与观测一致 [S3.p7][S3.p8][S3.p10]。

quote: Our findings in this work further demonstrate that such gray extinction curves can explain the characteristic v-shaped SEDs of LRDs, as evidenced by accumulated large samples, without considering multiple components such as host galaxies or scattered AGN light.
claim: 论文提出一个LRDs的SED模型：假设典型AGN的入射辐射被延展尘埃介质包裹，采用类似猎户座星云或某些AGN环境的消光律，用灰消光在λ<3000 Å产生平坦紫外谱，在λ>4000 Å产生红色光学连续谱，无需额外恒星辐射或AGN散射光 [S1.p6][S2.p6]。

claim: 信号区确定为 340 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 380 GeV，并定义了两个验证区：380 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 500 GeV 和 m_{t\bar{t}} > 500 GeV，每个区域的 t\bar{t} 事件纯度均超过 90% [S1.SS2.p4]。

quote: Spin entanglement is detected from the measurement of a single observable D D , inferred from the angle between the charged leptons in their parent top- and antitop-quark rest frames.
claim: 论文利用顶夸克-反顶夸克对的自旋关联来探测量子纠缠效应，通过测量由带电轻子在各自母顶夸克静止系中夹角推断的单一观测量 D 来探测自旋纠缠 [S1.p2][abstract]。

quote: In both of the validation regions, with no entanglement signal, the measurements are found to agree with the predictions from different MC setups within the uncertainties.
claim: 在两个无纠缠信号的验证区，测量结果在不同蒙特卡洛设置的不确定性范围内与预测一致，作为对测量方法的一致性检验 [S1.SS4.p1]。

quote: Protocols for measurement-only topological quantum computation simplify these operations, reducing them to fusion alone.
claim: 论文旨在实现拓扑量子计算中测量-only 方案所需的费米子宇称投影测量，即确定一对 Majorana 零能模共享的费米子宇称 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: In devices A and B, we do not observe any RTS, as discussed in Sec. S6.2.
claim: 准粒子注入实验显示驻留时间随偏压增加而减半，而断开量子点与纳米线连接后随机电报信号消失 [S3.p12][S3.p13]。

quote: Fig. S9 shows data from device B (measurement B1) made in a different dilution refrigerator with the same wiring configuration.
claim: 实验在 InAs-Al 异质结器件上进行，作者对器件 A 进行了测量 A1 和 A2，并在不同稀释制冷机中测量了器件 B [S3.p11][A6.SS1.p2]。

quote: We see a decrease of the well known oscillatory frequency of F and particularly Li atoms in the MACE simulation.
claim: 在动力学方面，MACE 模拟中 Li 和 F 原子的速度自相关函数振荡频率降低，且两者出现深度相近的极小值，形状相似，表明液相运动具有更明显的类固态振荡成分 [S3.p4]。

quote: the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：经典原子模型（Buckingham 和 BHM 势）在生成熔融 LiF 的忠实热物理数据方面存在不足，其预测的粘度在温度轴上存在明显偏移 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: the goal and emphasis of this work is the calculation and prediction of transport properties such as viscosity rather than determining the melting point accurately which is a task for future investigations.
claim: 作者指出，分子模拟中熔点的确定受多种因素影响，例如周期性边界条件导致没有实验中的自由表面或界面，以及模拟体系尺寸较小导致缺乏长波长和低频声子，因此从晶体结构逐步加热的方法可能并不普遍准确，确定熔点需要自由能计算或相共存模拟等其他方法 [S3.p3]。

quote: One shortcoming of classical methods is their inability to provide uncertainty estimates for predictions, which are essential for evaluating the reliability of the results.
claim: 作者指出，经典方法的一个缺点是难以提供预测的不确定性估计，而这对评估结果可靠性至关重要 [S1.SS1.p1]。
